title: OUKITEL WP62 device identity metadata
description: Device identity only: replays the SystemInfo android_build_fingerprint, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version that a OUKITEL WP62 capture recorded, over the android-scroll-standard real base. It is not a OUKITEL WP62 trace: apart from this identity and the case marker slice, every packet comes from the base.
known_issues: Derived metadata, not a device trace: only android_build_fingerprint, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version come from the OUKITEL WP62 capture; processes, scheduling, slices and all other metadata belong to the android-scroll-standard base.
The source capture is kept outside this repository. Its device serial number and every other per-unit identifier were removed; only build-level identity is kept.

android.device: OUKITEL WP62 identity over nubia pacific base

source.origin: SmartPerfetto deterministic trace generator; device identity values copied from a maintainer device capture that is not committed
source.consent: maintainer decision 2026-10-04: commit build-level device identity only
